Example Cloud Certified: Network Administrator Associate

Plan and run a network deployment for an organization, using the administration console, the command line, and the monitoring tools that ship with the platform.

Prepare for the exam

Review the exam guide, then book a seat with a proctor. The exam is offered in a testing centre and online, and the fee varies by the country the exam is taken in.

Renew every twelve months

An assessment on the learning site renews the award at no cost. An award that is not renewed expires and stops appearing on a public profile.
